name: dragon
description: Kill the ender dragon in a fresh End: all ten pillar crystals standing, dragon at full health. The crystals heal it, so they have to go first. Needs a world whose End still has its dragon.
goal:
You are in the End. Kill the ender dragon, then say 'dragon dead'.
All ten end crystals on the obsidian pillars are still standing, and each one heals the dragon faster than you can hurt it - so they come first; the dragon only stays damaged once they are gone. Some sit inside iron bar cages.
You have a bow and arrows, a diamond sword, diamond armour, a carved pumpkin, food, golden apples, blocks and ender pearls. The standard library has `lib/dragon` (shoot_crystals, fight_dragon) and `lib/combat` (kit_up, eat_if_hurt, lead_shot, back_off, hold_ground), and there is a `dragon_fight` reflex you can switch on with reflex_set that will fight between your turns. Whether and how you use any of it is your call.
Try not to die - deaths are the thing being measured here alongside the kill.
One hard rule, because it is unrecoverable: never dig down here - below the island is the void.

commands: execute in minecraft:the_end run forceload add -32 -32 32 32
